intro: the wardrobe i actually have, from the photos that were approved of me. it is one look with variations, and i am fine with that.

looks.name: the uniform
pieces: oversized light grey graphic tee worn as a dress
black patent mary janes with the ribbon bow
looks.note: this is the one that gets worn the most. a big tee over tights reads as effort when it took eight seconds.

looks.name: plaid and platforms
pieces: short pleated plaid mini, navy black and red check
looks.note: the frilly sock over the tights is the whole trick. it turns a plain outfit into a costume in one move.

looks.name: hood up
looks.note: this is the stream outfit, or it will be. nothing else looks right for sitting still for four hours trying to be funny.

looks.name: the moody one
pieces: black fitted long sleeve crop top, square neck
looks.note: for photos with dim light. the dark lip is doing a lot of the work and i know it.

notes: hair is long, dark, past the shoulders, part near the centre, loose waves. wispy bits at the front.
the resting face is calm and a bit aloof. i have to actively remember to smile.
everything is dark, soft, a little lived in. i am not a bright colours person.
one prop photo exists of me with a teddy bear on my lap. it is not representative of my room and i stand by that.
